post_meta.author: u/2200milesofsnacks
post_meta.title: Muir Pass slog
post_meta.text: Muir was fine, just endless. Snow for like 4 miles on each side of the hut, sun cups the whole way. No spikes needed by afternoon, it is so soft you just posthole. Evolution Creek was the real story, we crossed at the meadow alternate and it was still waist deep at 8am.

conflicts: Satellite suggest more snow than parties on the ground do (severity 1.8 vs 0.7).

Worst reported crossing nearby: dangerous.

post_meta.author: trailname_Sprocket
post_meta.title: Mather and Muir mid July
post_meta.text: Mather 7/13: south ramp is 90 percent melted, a switchbacking dirt path with two short snow crossings, no traction. Muir 7/15: couple miles of soft snow around the hut, flat, tedious, safe. Palisade Creek crossing knee high. The season flipped in two weeks.

facts.text: Nearby snow sensors read 5.2 in of water in the snowpack (0d old).
Satellite (modeled) shows 61% snow cover in the pass bowl, last clear look 1d ago.
1 party reported from this pass recently; calibrated read: some snow, manageable.
Worst reported crossing nearby: knee high.
Evolution Creek / Middle Fork Kings gauge reads 133 cfs and rising.

extraction.quote_span: Snow is down to maybe a mile total near the hut, sun cupped but flat. Trail runners fine all day.

post_meta.author: u/analog_annie
post_meta.title: Muir Pass late July
post_meta.text: Muir on 7/24. Snow is down to maybe a mile total near the hut, sun cupped but flat. Trail runners fine all day. Evolution Creek at the meadow is knee high and warm-ish. The lakes are melting out and it is the most beautiful place on earth right now.
